title: An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Mira arrives at dusk
scenes.purpose: Establish the dusk storybook stage, the village and Mira as the warm hero
visuals: Static dusk sky gradient, moon, stars, lavender far hills, sage ridge and hill (cached Canvas/Rough.js layer)
Title placard and caption placard hang over the stage
Mira walks in from the left with alternating leg poses
Three pop-up houses unfold upward on the ridge, staggered
Near foliage drifts into place as a measured parallax settle
assets: Procedural houses, foliage and background (Rough.js + Canvas 2D)

beats.development: Mira walks from x150 to x300 (step pose swaps); houses pop up at 0.25, 0.40 and 0.55s; she raises the watering can from 0.85s
captions: An idea becomes a connected system
Mira watered it, and the whole village lit up.

scenes.title: The idea blooms
scenes.purpose: Show the small idea being nurtured and lighting up
visuals: Stem grows, leaves open, the gold flower lamp blooms
Warm glow and a cream light ring expand from the flower

beats.development: Water drops fall (1.05–1.55s), stem grows (1.2s), the flower blooms (1.4s), and the glow and ring expand (1.45–2.05s)

scenes.title: The village connects
scenes.purpose: The idea becomes a connected system: light travels to every house and the houses link together
visuals: Three gold light arcs draw from the flower to each roof with a travelling bead
Windows switch from dark to lit with warm halos as each arc arrives
A dotted cream link joins the houses
Mira swaps to a happy expression and relaxes the can
assets: Procedural arcs, window glows and link

beats.development: The arcs draw at 1.6, 1.7 and 1.8s; the windows light at 2.0, 2.15 and 2.3s; the link draws from 2.3s; Mira turns happy at 2.35s
The completed lit village holds for reading
captions: Mira watered it, and the whole village lit up.

findings: All motion settles by 2.6s; the full scene is readable before 2.7s
Text placards stay static throughout, so contrast does not vary
justifiedHolds: 2.6–3.0s final hold so the caption can be read against the lit village

notes: Silent preview: no music, effects or voice

Recipe coverage: no optional preview recipes were supplied; this refresh demonstrates the source-frame lessons (scene-dependent dusk lighting state, a warm terracotta hero as the focal mass, lit openings as the only warm interior light, stage-piece pop-ups, dark placard with cream lettering)
